title: Romantic 1
description: Revise concepts associated with Romantic up to Higher. These features and forms may also occur in other periods.

items.prompt: Name the 19th-century historical period associated with Chopin and Liszt, expressive rubato, chromatic harmony and an expanded orchestra.
A large-scale, multi-movement work for orchestra.
Name the type of orchestral work featuring an instrumental soloist, rather than its historical period.
In the Western classical stage tradition, a sung drama uses solo arias, recitative and choruses with orchestral accompaniment. Name this type of work.
A German Romantic art song for solo voice and piano.
As a keyboard instrument, pressing a key causes a felt-covered hammer to strike a string.
Name the general pitch adjective for movement by semitones, including notes outside the main key, rather than the name of a particular densely packed chord.
The performer speeds up and slows down slightly for expression while keeping the music flowing.
A solo section in a concerto that lets the performer show musical and technical skill.
A main melody or musical idea is stated and then returns several times in altered forms.
